defects.observation: Create Task A and Task B, persist a scope approval decision for B, then INSERT invalidated_revisions(A, revision1, B decision). SQLite accepts the wrong Task authority link instead of rejecting it. The decision is unused, so no preexisting UNIQUE constraint masks the missing link.
defects.expected: Invalidation must reference the authority decision belonging to the same Task/revision; invalid cross-Task links must be rejected.
defects.qualification: Database integrity adversary using the test-owned SQLite connection. No public repository method cross-Task bypass was claimed.

settings_finding_resolution.current_run: Settings/spec change preserves the current run's immutable revision/settings/retry snapshot; subsequent retry decision links new settings and records count3; old run/decision retain count3 through reopen.
settings_finding_resolution.distinct_new_run: A separate normal run may start at count0; this was confirmed and is NOT reported as a reset defect.
settings_finding_resolution.prior_test_expectation: The initial independent expectation disallowed a distinct new normal run at0. Root clarified the ticket boundary; only the new test expectation was corrected and rerun. Existing worker tests were not modified.

coverage.closed_error: Closed valid read/write operations fail explicitly and cannot add delivery/shell/takeover/run history.
